description:
You are an academic advisor creating a visual prerequisite map for a new 'AI & Robotics' specialization. 

1. Open the course data file at `~/Desktop/curriculum_data.csv` to see the list of 20 courses, their Schedule (Year/Semester), and Prerequisite dependencies.

2. Create a new diagram in diagrams.net (draw.io) named `ai_curriculum_map.drawio` in the `~/Diagrams/` folder.

3. Structure the diagram using a Swimlane Pool (or horizontal containers) to clearly separate the 4 Academic Years (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3, Year 4).

4. Create a labeled node (rectangle) for EVERY course listed in the CSV. The label must include the Course Code and Name (e.g., 'CS101 Intro to Programming'). Place them in the correct Year swimlane.

5. Draw directed arrows representing all prerequisites listed in the CSV (Arrow points FROM Prerequisite TO the Follow-up course).

6. Apply color coding to the course nodes based on their 'Type' in the CSV:
   - Core courses: One color (e.g., Blue)
   - Math/GenEd courses: A second color (e.g., Green)
   - AI/Specialization courses: A third color (e.g., Orange/Red)

7. When finished, export the diagram as a PDF to `~/Diagrams/ai_curriculum_map.pdf`.

IMPORTANT: Handle any 'Update Available' dialogs by clicking Cancel/Esc so you can work.
